data: 37 included clips, 34 source labels; 2 pending excluded
fold_scheme: Leave one original clip out, only labels with at least two independent source clips; all augmentations and normalization fit only on fold training data
threshold_selection: unchanged from v2, no held-out calibration
candidate_change: same TCN architecture; balanced label batches; monotonic tempo/crop jitter and small synthetic landmark dropout only in train
model_promotion: exploratory comparison on same small historical data; no deployment quality claim; retain v2 tcn unless candidate improves correct accepted predictions without more accepted errors, then still label provisional
unknown_probes: 2 unsupported pending clips and non-person synthetic scenes, not a calibrated open-set benchmark
